scope: Different-author, read-only audit of the consumed M1845 C2 fresh-mapped production-energy attempt, its double-sealed attempt latch and failure quarantine, and selected unsealed private-build diagnostic logs. No EDA, simulation, SAIF, PTPX, DC, PT, Formality, license, GPU, remote, commit, or push operation was started. No RTL, TB, runner, docs/359, ucli.key, predecessor evidence, or private build was mutated or promoted.
verdict: M1845 is correctly FAIL_CLOSED. Both mapped VCS compilations completed, but the first and only simulation, K8/case0, terminated at 30000 ps in SIM_k8_0 because the 11-bit aggregate of three public mapped fault outputs and eight TB endpoint-fault taps contained X/Z. The SAIF power window had been enabled but never completed and no SAIF file exists. Only the source packet cover matched; endpoint, result/commit, and done covers did not. No numerical result, production functional PASS, PTPX, power, or energy result exists. The unique attempt is consumed with automatic_retry=false and must not be retried. Source-level reset/assignment structure makes the public mapped trio the most credible unknown class, but M1845 has no per-bit runtime evidence, so the direct proof boundary remains the full aggregate and no specific signal may be named as proven.

classification.reason_for_limit: The M1845 monitor uses one aggregate $isunknown and prints no per-bit values. The TB endpoint_protocol_fault_q source resets to zero and subsequently assigns only literal zero/one or retains state, making an endpoint-generated X unlikely after the exercised reset, but this structural argument does not replace per-bit mapped runtime evidence.

findings.finding: The first K8 mapped production simulation reaches an aggregate fault-vector X/Z at 30 ns after one source packet but before any endpoint, result/commit, or done acceptance.
findings.impact: M1845 cannot admit mapped functionality, production SAIF, PTPX, component power, or component energy. Retrying the consumed namespace or suppressing the aggregate check would violate the fail-closed contract.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep M1845 consumed and immutable. If recovery is pursued, use a new additive diagnostic namespace that prints every public and endpoint fault bit while retaining the original aggregate fatal; only after exact localization and root-cause repair may a new different-author source review and exact launch release be considered.
